title: Understanding and Mitigating Library-Related Issues in LLM-Generated Code
title_zh: 理解与缓解大型语言模型生成代码中的库相关问题

paragraphs.en: Software practitioners increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate code that integrates external libraries. However, LLMs often produce incorrect library usage, such as invalid imports, outdated API calls, and hallucinated dependencies, leading to compilation or runtime failures that reduce the reliability of AI-assisted software development. In this paper, we propose an agentic approach to mitigate library-related errors in LLM-generated code. More specifically, we first conduct an exploratory study to characterize the library-related issues produced by LLMs. Our analysis of 100 LLM-generated code files reveals that 84% of generated files contain at least one library-related error, with recurring patterns including incorrect import paths, missing imports, hallucinated libraries, deprecated library usage, and unused imports. Based on these findings, we design an agentic approach that integrates task analysis, documentation grounding, code generation, and automated validation to improve library usage during code synthesis. We evaluate our approach on 300 code generation tasks derived from real-world implementations of rapidly evolving Python frameworks, including LangChain and AutoGen, across five LLMs: GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3, Mistral, and Llama 3. The results show that our approach consistently improves code generation quality across all evaluated models, reducing library-related errors by 38.1%–54.6% and increasing code correctness by up to 16%.
paragraphs.zh: 软件从业者越来越依赖大型语言模型（LLM）来生成能够集成外部库的代码。 然而，LLM 常常会产生错误的库使用方式，例如无效的导入、过时的 API 调用以及虚构的依赖关系，从而导致编译或运行时失败，降低了人工智能辅助软件开发的可信度。 在本文中，我们提出了一种智能体方法，用于缓解 LLM 生成代码中出现的与库相关的错误。 更具体地说，我们首先进行了一项探索性研究，以描述 LLM 所生成的与库相关的问题。 我们对 100 个 LLM 生成的代码文件进行分析后发现，84% 的生成文件中至少包含一个与库相关的错误，其中反复出现的模式包括错误的导入路径、缺失的导入、虚构的库、过时的库使用以及未使用的导入。 基于这些发现，我们设计了一种智能体方法，该方法整合了任务分析、文档依据、代码生成和自动化验证，以提升代码合成过程中对库的使用质量。 我们在 300 个代码生成任务上评估了我们的方法，这些任务源自 LangChain 和 AutoGen 等快速演进的 Python 框架的实际应用，并覆盖了五种 LLM：GPT-5、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3、Mistral 和 Llama 3。 结果表明，我们的方法在所有受评估的模型中都能持续提高代码生成质量，将库相关的错误减少了 38.1%–54.6%，并将代码正确性提升了最多 16%。

paragraphs.en: LLMs have transformed software engineering by enabling new forms of automation across various development activities, including code generation [ 1 ] , program repair [ 2 ] , and testing [ 3 ] . Among these applications, code generation has received particular attention due to the ability of LLMs to translate natural language descriptions into executable programs [ 4 ] . However, generating functionally correct code requires not only producing valid program logic but also correctly interacting with external libraries and their APIs [ 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 通过在各种开发活动中实现新型自动化，彻底改变了软件工程，包括代码生成 [ 1 ]、程序修复 [ 2 ] 和测试 [ 3 ]。 在这些应用中，代码生成尤为受到关注，因为 LLM 能够将自然语言描述转换为可执行的程序 [ 4 ]。 然而，生成功能正确的代码不仅需要产生有效的程序逻辑，还需要正确地与外部库及其 API 进行交互 [ 5 ]。

sents.en: However, generating functionally correct code requires not only producing valid program logic but also correctly interacting with external libraries and their APIs [ 5 ] .
sents.zh: 然而，生成功能正确的代码不仅需要产生有效的程序逻辑，还需要正确地与外部库及其 API 进行交互 [ 5 ]。

paragraphs.en: A major challenge in this context is that libraries are not static artifacts. They continuously evolve through version updates, refactoring, and module reorganization, causing previously valid usage patterns to become obsolete [ 6 ] . Since LLMs are pre-trained on historical code repositories, their knowledge may not reflect the current state of rapidly evolving libraries. As a result, generated code may contain incorrect library imports, outdated APIs, or even nonexistent modules [ 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在此背景下，一个主要挑战在于库并非静态的产物。 它们通过版本更新、重构和模块重组持续演变，导致先前有效的使用模式变得过时 [ 6 ] 。 由于大型语言模型是在历史代码仓库上预训练的，其知识可能无法反映快速演变的库的当前状态。 因此，生成的代码可能包含错误的库导入、过时的 API，甚至是不存在的模块 [ 5 ] 。

sents.zh: 因此，生成的代码可能包含错误的库导入、过时的 API，甚至是不存在的模块 [ 5 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Prior work shows that 4.6% of the libraries appearing in generated code cannot be resolved automatically due to structural mismatches between import names and installable packages [ 7 ] . Although this percentage may appear limited, such issues often result in complete execution failures because a single incorrect dependency can prevent the entire program from running. These failures require developers to manually investigate library versions and compatibility issues, reducing the productivity gains expected from LLM-based development.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究表明，在生成的代码中出现的库中有 4.6% 无法被自动解析，这是因为导入名称与可安装包之间存在结构不匹配的问题 [ 7 ]。 尽管这一比例看似有限，但此类问题常常导致程序完全无法执行，因为单个错误的依赖项就可能阻止整个程序的运行。 这些失败迫使开发者手动调查库的版本和兼容性问题，从而降低了基于 LLM 的开发本应带来的效率提升。

paragraphs.en: This problem is amplified by the rapid evolution of modern software libraries, which frequently introduce API refactoring, module reorganization, and backward-incompatible changes [ 6 ] . The mismatch between the static code knowledge learned during LLM training and the continuously changing state of libraries often leads to plausible-looking but incorrect code. This issue is particularly severe for fast-evolving frameworks used in LLM-powered applications, such as LangChain [ 8 ] and AutoGen [ 9 ] , where frequent API changes can cause generated code to fail due to outdated imports, missing dependencies, or deprecated APIs. Any incorrect library import can turn into total failure, as downstream components rely on precise module structures [ 10 , 11 ] . Unfortunately, leading LLMs such as GPT-5.2 fail in resolving these issues, leaving developers to debug confidently generated but fundamentally broken code [ 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 现代软件库的快速演变加剧了这一问题，因为这类库经常引入 API 重构、模块重组以及向后不兼容的变更 [ 6 ]。 LLM 训练期间学到的静态代码知识与不断变化的库状态之间的不匹配，常常导致生成的代码看似合理却存在错误。 对于用于 LLM 驱动应用（如 LangChain [ 8 ] 和 AutoGen [ 9 ]）的快速演进框架而言，这一问题尤为严重，因为频繁的 API 变更可能导致生成的代码因导入过时、依赖缺失或 API 弃用而失效。 任何错误的库导入都可能导致彻底失败，因为下游组件依赖于精确的模块结构 [ 10 , 11 ]。 遗憾的是，GPT-5.2 等主流 LLM 无法解决这些问题，迫使开发者不得不调试那些看似可靠却存在根本性错误的代码 [ 12 ]。

paragraphs.en: To understand and quantify this problem, we first conduct an exploratory study of LLM-generated code files. We collect 100 Python code files generated for real-world programming tasks involving external libraries and manually analyze the encountered library-related failures. From this analysis, we derive five dominant error categories: Incorrect Import Paths, Missing Imports, Hallucinated Imports, Deprecated Imports, and Unused Imports. The results shows that 84% of generated files contain library-related errors, with an average of 2.7 errors per faulty file. These findings suggests that library-related issues represent a significant barrier to reliable LLM-based code generation and motivate the need for approaches that explicitly address library evolution and API compatibility.
paragraphs.zh: 为了理解并量化这个问题，我们首先对大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码文件进行了一项探索性研究。 我们收集了为涉及外部库的真实世界编程任务而生成的 100 个 Python 代码文件，并手动分析了其中遇到的与库相关的故障。 通过这项分析，我们归纳出五种主要的错误类别：不正确的导入路径、缺失的导入项、幻觉导入项、过时的导入项以及未使用的导入项。 研究结果表明，84% 的生成文件中存在与库相关的错误，每个有错误的文件平均包含 2.7 个错误。 这些发现表明，与库相关的问题构成了可靠 LLM 代码生成的重要障碍，并凸显了需要开发能够明确应对库演化和 API 兼容性的方法。

paragraphs.en: After quantifying these issues, we propose an agentic system designed to mitigate library-related errors in LLM-generated code. Our approach grounds code generation in up-to-date documentation through a closed-loop pipeline composed of four main components: an Analyzer agent that identifies required dependencies, collects and filters relevant API documentation using a Documentation Retrieval module , a Code Generator agent that produces documentation-grounded implementations, and a Validator agent that detects and corrects inconsistencies through feedback from a Compilation and Dependency Management module. This design enables continuous validation of library usage against current APIs and reduces reliance on outdated model knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 在量化这些问题之后，我们提出了一种智能体系统，旨在减少大型语言模型生成的代码中与库相关的错误。 我们的方法通过一个由四个主要组件组成的闭环流程，将代码生成建立在最新的文档基础之上：一个分析智能体，用于识别所需的依赖项，并使用文档检索模块收集和筛选相关的 API 文档；一个代码生成智能体，用于生成基于文档的实现；以及一个验证智能体，通过编译与依赖管理模块的反馈来检测并纠正不一致之处。 这种设计使得库的使用能够持续地根据当前 API 进行验证，并减少了对过时模型知识的依赖。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our system on 300 code generation tasks derived from real-world implementations of fast-evolving Python frameworks and compare it against direct prompting across five LLMs: GPT-5 [ 13 ] , DeepSeek-V3 [ 14 ] , Qwen3 [ 15 ] , Mistral [ 16 ] , and Llama3 [ 17 ] . The results show that our approach consistently improves code correctness across all evaluated models, reducing library-related errors by up to 54.6% and increasing correctness rates by up to 16%. Furthermore, to understand the contribution of each component to the overall effectiveness of the system, we further conduct an ablation study by removing individual modules from the complete pipeline while keeping the remaining components unchanged. The results show that each component contributes to reducing library-related errors and improving code reliability, highlighting the importance of combining dependency analysis, documentation retrieval, and iterative validation.

paragraphs.en: To illustrate the problem of incorrect library usage and imports in LLM-generated code, in this section, we begin with a motivating example. We prompt ChatGPT to generate Python code implementing a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that operates on a PDF document using the prompt shown in Listing 1 .

paragraphs.en: RAG pipelines are representative of modern application development: they rely on multiple third-party libraries, require correct composition of modular components, and are commonly used in real-world LLM-based systems. We used GPT-5.2, which describes itself as capable of reasoning, code generation, and retrieval-augmented tasks, and which reports a knowledge cutoff in August 2025.

Although the generated code correctly identifies the LangChain components typically required to implement such a system, three of the generated import statements are incompatible with the current version of the library. paragraphs.en: A closer analysis of these errors reveals that most are caused by incorrect or outdated module paths. For instance, in recent versions of LangChain, the PyPDFLoader class must be imported from langchain_community.document_loaders , whereas the generated code attempts to import it from langchain.document_loaders . Similar issues affect other components, including question-answering and vector store utilities. Notably, the imported symbols themselves are valid LangChain abstractions; the errors arise solely from changes in how these components are organized within the library.
paragraphs.zh: 对这些错误进行更深入的分析可以发现，大多数错误都是由不正确或过时的模块路径引起的。 例如，在 LangChain 的近期版本中，PyPDFLoader 类必须从 langchain_community.document_loaders 导入，而生成代码却试图从 langchain.document_loaders 导入它。 类似的问题也影响了其他组件，包括问答和向量存储工具。 值得注意的是，被导入的符号本身是有效的 LangChain 抽象；这些错误完全源于这些组件在库中的组织方式发生了变化。

paragraphs.en: This example highlights a broader challenge in automating code generation when programs depend on rapidly evolving libraries. Modern frameworks such as LangChain frequently undergo refactoring, modularization, and API reorganization, causing previously valid import paths and usage patterns to become obsolete across versions. Although the underlying functionality may remain available, changes in library structure can cause the generated code to fail during execution.
paragraphs.zh: 这个例子凸显了代码生成自动化中一个更广泛的问题：当程序依赖快速演变的库时，自动化会面临挑战。 LangChain 等现代框架经常经历重构、模块化以及 API 重组，导致先前有效的导入路径和使用模式在不同版本中变得过时。 尽管底层功能可能仍然存在，但库结构的变化可能导致生成的代码在执行时失败。

sents.en: Modern frameworks such as LangChain frequently undergo refactoring, modularization, and API reorganization, causing previously valid import paths and usage patterns to become obsolete across versions.

sents.zh: 尽管底层功能可能仍然存在，但库结构的变化可能导致生成的代码在执行时失败。

paragraphs.en: These failures can be attributed to two main factors. First, LLMs may hallucinate libraries, modules, or API usage patterns that do not exist in the target environment. Second, they rely on pre-trained knowledge acquired from historical code and documentation, which may not reflect the current state of rapidly evolving libraries. In both cases, the generated code may contain incorrect dependencies or API usages, leading to execution failures.
paragraphs.zh: 这些失败可以归因于两个主要因素。 首先，大型语言模型可能会虚构出目标环境中并不存在的库、模块或 API 使用模式。 其次，它们依赖从历史代码和文档中获取的预训练知识，而这些知识可能无法反映快速演变的库的当前状态。 在这两种情况下，生成的代码都可能包含错误的依赖关系或 API 使用方式，从而导致执行失败。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this example, this work has two main research goals. First, we investigate the types of import-related errors that LLMs produce in generated code, with the objective of identifying and classifying recurring error patterns, particularly in rapidly evolving libraries. Second, we develop a novel approach to fix import errors in the generated code by enabling the model to autonomously identify import failures and recover by discovering and applying the correct import statements using available documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 受此例子的启发，本研究有两个主要研究目标。 首先，我们研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在生成代码中产生的与导入相关的错误类型，旨在识别和分类重复出现的错误模式，尤其是在快速演变的库中。 其次，我们开发了一种新方法，用于修复生成代码中的导入错误，该方法使模型能够自主识别导入失败，并通过查找和应用可用文档中的正确导入语句来实现恢复。

sents.en: First, we investigate the types of import-related errors that LLMs produce in generated code, with the objective of identifying and classifying recurring error patterns, particularly in rapidly evolving libraries.

paragraphs.en: To better understand the limitations of LLM-generated code when interacting with external libraries, we conduct an exploratory study that systematically analyzes generated programs to characterize and quantify library-related import issues, particularly those caused by the use of fast-evolving frameworks. The objective of this study is to identify common patterns of library misuse and measure their prevalence across generated files. Understanding these issues is essential for designing approaches that can automatically detect and mitigate library-related failures. Furthermore, quantifying the frequency of different error patterns allows us to identify the most dominant failure modes and provides insights into the challenges that should be addressed to improve the reliability of LLM-based code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更好地理解大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码在与外部库交互时的局限性，我们开展了一项探索性研究，系统性地分析生成的程序，以描述和量化与库相关的导入问题，尤其是由快速演进的框架使用所引发的问题。 本研究的目标是识别常见的库误用模式，并衡量这些模式在生成文件中的普遍程度。 理解这些问题对于设计能够自动检测并缓解与库相关故障的方法至关重要。 此外，量化不同错误模式的出现频率有助于我们识别最主导的故障类型，并为改进基于LLM的代码生成可靠性所需应对的挑战提供洞见。

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, there is no publicly available dataset that captures LLM code generation behavior using real-world reference implementations. Existing benchmarks often rely on fixed-version libraries, which may not capture the challenges introduced by evolving APIs and abstractions. To address this gap, we curated a dataset of 100 prompt–code pairs through a three-stage process: repository selection, prompt derivation, and LLM-based generation.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，目前尚无公开可用的数据集能够利用真实世界的参考实现来捕捉大型语言模型（LLM）的代码生成行为。 现有的基准测试通常依赖固定版本的库，这可能无法反映不断演变的 API 和抽象机制所带来的挑战。 为了填补这一空白，我们通过一个包含三个阶段的流程整理出了一个由 100 个提示–代码对组成的数据集：仓库选择、提示推导以及基于 LLM 的生成。

paragraphs.en: First, we collected open-source GitHub repositories using LLM-centric frameworks, such as LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI, to derive realistic programming tasks. Using the GitHub REST API, we filtered the retrieved repositories to retain public Python projects containing executable source code while excluding forks and repositories that did not satisfy our predefined selection criteria. This process yielded approximately 400 repositories. From this collection, we manually selected 100 repositories that contained concrete usage of the target frameworks and relevant API interactions. These repositories were used to identify realistic scenarios, API usage patterns, and task requirements for prompt construction.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们使用以 LLM 为核心的框架（例如 LangChain、AutoGen 和 CrewAI）收集了开源 GitHub 仓库，从而提取出真实的编程任务。 通过 GitHub REST API，我们对检索到的仓库进行了筛选，保留包含可执行源代码的公共 Python 项目，同时排除分支仓库以及不符合我们预设选择标准的仓库。 这一过程共产生了大约 400 个仓库。 从这些仓库中，我们手动挑选了 100 个包含目标框架具体用法和相关 API 交互的仓库。 这些仓库被用于识别构建提示词所需的真实场景、API 使用模式以及任务要求。

paragraphs.en: Following repository selection, we transformed functionality from the reference implementations into natural language prompts. Each prompt was designed to clearly specify the task requirements, expected behavior, and relevant constraints [ 18 ] . We use ChatGPT for this step due to its demonstrated effectiveness in software engineering tasks and its ability to translate code functionality into natural language descriptions [ 19 ] . Each resulting prompt was then manually reviewed by two of the authors and refined to ensure clarity, completeness, and consistency with the reference implementation. This validation step ensures that the prompts are understandable to a human developer and accurately reflect the functionality implemented in the corresponding reference code. An example of a resulting prompt is shown in Listing 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在选定仓库之后，我们将参考实现中的功能转换成了自然语言提示。 每个提示都经过精心设计，以明确说明任务要求、预期行为和相关约束 [ 18 ] 。 我们在此步骤中使用 ChatGPT，因为它在软件工程任务中已被证明行之有效，并且能够将代码功能转换为自然语言描述 [ 19 ] 。 随后，两位作者对每个生成的提示进行了人工审查，并加以完善，以确保其清晰性、完整性和与参考实现的一致性。 这一验证步骤确保了提示对人类开发者而言易于理解，并能准确反映相应参考代码中实现的功能。 一个生成提示的示例展示在列表 2 中。

paragraphs.en: In the final stage, the curated prompts were provided to LLMs, including Mistral and DeepSeek, to generate corresponding code solutions. These outputs form the basis of our evaluation, while the original repository implementations serve as reference implementations for assessing the generated solutions. The resulting dataset of 100 prompt–code pairs covers application scenarios such as data ingestion pipelines, multi-agent coordination workflows, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and external API integration.

paragraphs.en: To systematically analyze library-related errors in LLM-generated code, we developed a structured annotation process in which we identify, categorize, and quantify the types of issues occurring in import statements and library usage.
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统性地分析大型语言模型生成的代码中存在的库相关错误，我们开发了一种结构化标注流程，用于识别、分类和量化导入语句及库使用中出现的问题类型。

paragraphs.en: Prior to formal annotation, the two annotators jointly reviewed a randomly selected subset of 25 code samples and discussed each sample to identify recurring patterns and types of library-related errors. This preliminary thematic analysis was conducted to establish a common understanding of the error types present in LLM-generated code, particularly given that agentic frameworks frequently undergo breaking changes to their APIs and module structures. Through discussion and comparison, the annotators identified recurring error patterns, refined guideline interpretations, and established a shared consensus for ambiguous cases (e.g., valid imports using deprecated APIs). These finalized themes and criteria guided all subsequent annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 在正式标注之前，两位标注员共同审阅了随机选出的 25 个代码样本的子集，并讨论了每个样本，以识别重复出现的模式以及库相关的错误类型。 这项初步的主题分析旨在建立对 LLM 生成代码中错误类型的共同理解，尤其是考虑到智能体框架的 API 和模块结构经常发生破坏性变更。 通过讨论和比较，标注员识别出了重复出现的错误模式，完善了指南的解释，并对模糊情况（例如使用已弃用 API 的有效导入）达成了共同共识。 这些最终确定的主题和标准指导了所有后续的标注工作。

paragraphs.en: Package Existence: Each top-level package was verified using documentation to ensure that it is published and correctly spelled. Third-party libraries were also cross-referenced with official documentation or reputable online sources [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 包的存在性：每个顶级包均通过文档进行了验证，以确保其已发布且拼写正确。 第三方库也通过与官方文档或权威在线资源交叉核对进行了验证 [ 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Following the initial exploratory review, recurring error patterns were synthesized into a formal taxonomy of import-related error categories. Using an open thematic analysis approach, annotators reviewed code samples to identify underlying error mechanisms, which were iteratively compared, grouped, and refined into a standardized schema. The resulting taxonomy abstracted specific failure modes into high-level analytical categories (e.g., structural path errors versus semantic hallucinations) and provided a consistent framework for subsequent annotation and quantitative analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在初步的探索性审查之后，重复出现的错误模式被整合为一份正式的进口相关错误类别分类体系。 采用开放式主题分析方法，标注人员审查了代码样本以识别潜在的错误机制，这些机制经过反复比较、分组和提炼，最终形成了一套标准化方案。 由此形成的分类体系将具体的故障模式抽象为高层分析类别（例如，结构路径错误与语义幻觉），并为后续的标注和定量分析提供了统一的框架。

paragraphs.en: During batch annotation, annotators independently classified code samples using the established taxonomy. After each batch, they held review meetings to resolve disagreements by consensus and refine annotation guidelines to improve consistency. Annotation quality was assessed by comparing results for each file across three agreement levels: Full Agreement, where both annotators identified the same issues, classifications, and error counts; Partial Agreement, where annotators agreed on most findings but differed on one or two classifications or identifications; and No Agreement, where findings differed substantially across multiple classifications, identifications, or error counts.
paragraphs.zh: 在批量标注过程中，标注员依据既定的分类体系独立对代码样本进行分类。 每批标注结束后，他们都会召开评审会议，通过共识解决分歧，并完善标注指南以提升一致性。 标注质量的评估方式是，将每份文件在三类一致程度下的结果进行对比：完全一致（两名标注员识别出的问题、分类和错误数量均相同）；部分一致（标注员对大多数发现意见一致，但在一个或两个分类或识别上存在差异）；以及无一致（多个分类、识别或错误数量上的发现存在显著差异）。

paragraphs.en: We present the results of our exploratory study based on the 100 annotated code files. To assess the reliability of our classification, we measured inter-annotator agreement using Cohen’s kappa [ 23 ] . The annotators achieved a Cohen’s kappa of κ = 0.86 \kappa=0.86 , indicating a very high level of agreement. For the small number of cases with initial disagreements, a joint reconciliation session was conducted to reach final consensus. We analyze the distribution of errors across our dataset of 100 evaluable prompt–code pairs, excluding 7 cases where no code was generated. Reported frequencies refer to individual error instances rather than unique files unless otherwise noted.

paragraphs.en: High Failure Prevalence: Of the 100 code files analyzed, 84 files contained at least one import-related error.
paragraphs.zh: 高故障发生率：在分析的 100 个代码文件中，有 84 个文件包含至少一个与导入相关的错误。

paragraphs.en: Error Density & Clustering: Within the 84 problematic files, we recorded a total of 228 distinct error instances, averaging approximately 2.7 errors per failing file.
paragraphs.zh: 错误密度与聚集性：在 84 个存在问题的文件中，我们共记录了 228 个不同的错误实例，平均每个出错的文件约有 2.7 个错误。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a taxonomy of import-related errors observed in LLM-generated code for rapidly evolving libraries. The taxonomy was developed during preliminary exploration and finalized prior to large-scale annotation, serving as the shared framework for all subsequent analysis. It consists of five categories (Table I ), each capturing a distinct deviation from correct, complete, and prompt-aligned import statements. The categories are not mutually exclusive, and a single code file may exhibit multiple error types.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种针对快速演进的库中 LLM 生成代码所观察到的导入相关错误的分类体系。 该分类体系在初步探索阶段制定，并在大规模标注前最终确定，作为后续所有分析的共同框架。 它包含五个类别（表 I），每个类别都捕捉了与正确、完整且符合提示的导入语句之间的特定偏差。 这些类别并非互斥的，单个代码文件可能同时存在多种错误类型。

paragraphs.en: These errors span both structural and semantic dimensions of library usage: incorrect import paths and missing imports reflect mismatches with actual module organization, while hallucinated imports and deprecated imports indicate discrepancies between the model’s internal knowledge and the current documented API. Such issues are particularly prevalent in agentic frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI, which differ from stable software ecosystems due to their rapid evolution and frequent breaking changes to internal hierarchies and core abstractions [ 24 , 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这些错误涵盖了库使用的结构和语义两个维度：不正确的导入路径和缺失的导入反映了实际模块组织的不匹配，而凭空生成的导入和过时的导入则表明模型内部知识与当前文档化的 API 存在差异。 这类问题在 LangChain、AutoGen 和 CrewAI 等智能体框架中尤为普遍，这些框架与稳定的软件生态系统不同，因为它们发展迅速，且内部层级和核心抽象经常发生破坏性变更 [ 24 , 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Incorrect import paths (40.8%): The most prevalent error type. In these cases, the model frequently selected the correct high-level library but failed to correctly navigate its internal module hierarchy, such as placing a class or function in an incorrect submodule. For example, the model generated from langchain.chat_models import ChatOpenAI , although ChatOpenAI is defined in langchain_openai . This pattern reflects the inherent instability of agentic framework architectures, where internal paths are frequently reorganized across versions. These libraries often undergo frequent API revisions and structural refactorings, similar to broader patterns seen in evolving software ecosystems where dependency networks grow in complexity and interface changes challenge developers [ 25 ] . The prevalence of this error type suggests that LLMs struggle not with recognizing which libraries to use, but with maintaining accurate, fine-grained knowledge of their internal structure.
paragraphs.zh: 错误的导入路径（40.8%）：最常见的错误类型。 在这些情况下，模型通常会选择正确的高级库，但未能正确导航其内部模块层级结构，例如将某个类或函数放置到错误的子模块中。 例如，模型生成了从 langchain.chat_models 导入 ChatOpenAI 的代码，尽管 ChatOpenAI 实际上定义在 langchain_openai 中。 这种模式反映了智能体框架架构固有的不稳定性，其内部路径在不同版本间经常会被重新组织。 这些库通常会频繁进行 API 修订和结构重构，这与不断演化的软件生态系统中更广泛的现象类似：依赖网络日益复杂，接口变化也给开发者带来了挑战 [25]。 这种错误类型的高发性表明，大语言模型的问题不在于识别该使用哪些库，而在于难以维持对其内部结构的准确、精细的知识。

sents.en: For example, the model generated from langchain.chat_models import ChatOpenAI , although ChatOpenAI is defined in langchain_openai .
sents.zh: 例如，模型生成了从 langchain.chat_models 导入 ChatOpenAI 的代码，尽管 ChatOpenAI 实际上定义在 langchain_openai 中。

sents.en: This pattern reflects the inherent instability of agentic framework architectures, where internal paths are frequently reorganized across versions.
sents.zh: 这种模式反映了智能体框架架构固有的不稳定性，其内部路径在不同版本间经常会被重新组织。

sents.en: These libraries often undergo frequent API revisions and structural refactorings, similar to broader patterns seen in evolving software ecosystems where dependency networks grow in complexity and interface changes challenge developers [ 25 ] .
sents.zh: 这些库通常会频繁进行 API 修订和结构重构，这与不断演化的软件生态系统中更广泛的现象类似：依赖网络日益复杂，接口变化也给开发者带来了挑战 [25]。

sents.en: The prevalence of this error type suggests that LLMs struggle not with recognizing which libraries to use, but with maintaining accurate, fine-grained knowledge of their internal structure.
sents.zh: 这种错误类型的高发性表明，大语言模型的问题不在于识别该使用哪些库，而在于难以维持对其内部结构的准确、精细的知识。

paragraphs.en: Missing imports (34.6%): Represented the second largest category. These errors occurred when required dependencies or framework components were omitted despite being necessary for execution. For example, AutoGen components were referenced in the generated code without including the required import autogen statement. Notably, a portion of these cases involved missing core components from the target frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI), highlighting an increased challenge when dealing with recently updated or less established ecosystems that may have evolving APIs. These findings suggest that LLMs may struggle to track the complete set of dependencies required for correct execution, particularly in frameworks with complex and rapidly changing abstractions.
paragraphs.zh: 缺少导入（34.6%）：这是第二大类别。 当必要的依赖项或框架组件被遗漏时，就会出现这些错误，尽管它们对于程序执行是必需的。 例如，生成的代码中引用了 AutoGen 组件，但没有包含所需的 import autogen 语句。 值得注意的是，其中一部分情况涉及目标框架（例如 LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI）的核心组件缺失，这凸显了在处理近期更新或尚未成熟的生态系统时所面临的更大挑战，因为它们的 API 可能仍在不断演变。 这些发现表明，大型语言模型可能在追踪正确执行所需的全部依赖项方面存在困难，尤其是在那些抽象层复杂且快速变化的框架中。

paragraphs.en: Hallucinated imports (12.3%): The third most frequent error type reveals a tendency for the model to fabricate plausible-sounding modules or classes when faced with uncertainty. For example, the model generated from openai import OpenAIGym , although OpenAIGym does not exist in the OpenAI library. Unlike incorrect paths, which often require minor corrections, hallucinated imports represent a more severe failure mode, as they reference non-existent components that cannot be resolved without external documentation or trial-and-error debugging. This highlights the limitations of relying solely on static model knowledge when generating code for fast-evolving agentic ecosystems.
paragraphs.zh: 幻觉导入（12.3%）：第三常见的错误类型表明，面对不确定性时，模型倾向于编造听起来合理的模块或类。 例如，模型生成了 from openai import OpenAIGym，尽管 OpenAIGym 在 OpenAI 库中并不存在。 与通常需要轻微修正的错误路径不同，幻觉导入代表了一种更严重的故障模式，因为它们引用了不存在的组件，而这些组件无法在没有外部文档或试错调试的情况下被解析。 这凸显了仅依赖静态模型知识为快速演化的智能体生态系统生成代码时的局限性。

In these cases, the imports were often syntactically valid in older versions of the library but contradicted the prompt’s intent to use newer, client-based or modularized interfaces.

paragraphs.zh: 未使用的导入（4.8%）：观察到这些冗余反映了效率问题，虽然严重程度较低，但仍会降低代码的清晰度和可维护性。 例如，模型在生成的脚本中包含了 requests 导入，但并未使用 requests 中的任何函数或类。

paragraphs.en: The observed error distributions reflect the architectural complexity and rapid evolution of agentic frameworks, which differ from more stable software ecosystems [ 26 ] . In the absence of stable usage patterns, models are more likely to fabricate plausible but unsupported imports or rely on outdated interfaces. Collectively, these findings show that import-related errors in agentic framework code are systematic, reflecting limitations in generating version-consistent code for rapidly evolving libraries and highlighting the need for library-aware approaches that can improve models’ ability to leverage accurate, up-to-date library information during code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 观察到的错误分布反映了智能体框架的架构复杂性和快速演变，这与更为稳定的软件生态系统有所不同 [ 26 ] 。 在缺乏稳定使用模式的情况下，模型更有可能编造看似合理但缺乏依据的导入操作，或依赖过时的接口。 综合来看，这些发现表明，智能体框架代码中与导入相关的错误具有系统性，反映了在生成快速演变的库的版本兼容代码方面的局限性，并凸显了需要采用能够感知库变化的方法，以增强模型在代码生成过程中利用准确、最新库信息的能力。

sents.zh: 综合来看，这些发现表明，智能体框架代码中与导入相关的错误具有系统性，反映了在生成快速演变的库的版本兼容代码方面的局限性，并凸显了需要采用能够感知库变化的方法，以增强模型在代码生成过程中利用准确、最新库信息的能力。

paragraphs.en: To address the problem of incorrect external library usage in LLM-generated code, we propose a novel agentic system for library-aware code generation that formulates code generation as an iterative and structured process. An overview of the system is presented in Figure 2 . The system takes as input a natural language task describing the desired functionality of the program. It then begins with task analysis and libraries documentation retrieval, proceeds through code generation, and finishes with automated validation and correction. The final output is a validated code solution that satisfies the task requirements while solving library-related issues.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决大型语言模型生成的代码中外部库使用不当的问题，我们提出了一种新颖的智能体系统，用于实现具备库意识的代码生成，并将代码生成过程构造成一种迭代且结构化的流程。 该系统的总体架构如图 2 所示。 该系统以描述程序所需功能的自然语言任务作为输入。 随后，系统首先进行任务分析和库文档检索，接着执行代码生成，最后完成自动化验证与修正。 最终输出是一个经过验证的代码解决方案，既能满足任务要求，又能解决与库相关的问题。

sents.en: To address the problem of incorrect external library usage in LLM-generated code, we propose a novel agentic system for library-aware code generation that formulates code generation as an iterative and structured process.

sents.zh: 该系统以描述程序所需功能的自然语言任务作为输入。

paragraphs.en: This workflow is implemented via three interacting agents: Analyzer agent, Code Generator agent, and Validator agent, each responsible for a specific stage of the process while communicating through shared modules for Documentation Retrieval and Compilation . We present more details about these agents in the following subsections.
paragraphs.zh: 该工作流程通过三个相互作用的智能体实现：分析智能体、代码生成智能体和验证智能体，每个智能体负责流程中的特定阶段，并通过共享的文档检索与编译模块进行通信。 我们将在以下子部分中详细介绍这些智能体。

paragraphs.en: The Analyzer prepares the information required for code generation. It receives as input a natural language code generation prompt describing the functionality of the program to be implemented, such as the prompt shown in Listing 1 . Based on this input, it first identifies the external libraries and modules required to implement the requested functionality, then retrieves and filters their corresponding documentation. The Analyzer performs these operations in two stages.

paragraphs.en: The first task consists of identifying the external libraries required to implement the requested functionality. To achieve this, the Analyzer is prompted to analyze the semantic requirements of the input task and identifies the required third-party libraries, frameworks, and submodules while explicitly excluding Python standard library modules. The prompt instructs the agent to return the extracted dependencies according to a predefined JSON schema, ensuring that the output can be reliably processed by subsequent components. The generated JSON representation contains the identified libraries, their associated modules, and their intended usage within the generated program, as illustrated in Listing 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 第一项任务是确定实现所请求功能所需的外部库。 为实现此目标，分析器会受命分析输入任务的语义需求，并识别所需的第三方库、框架和子模块，同时明确排除 Python 标准库模块。 该提示要求智能体按照预定义的 JSON 模式返回提取出的依赖项，以确保后续组件能够可靠地处理输出结果。 生成的 JSON 表示包含已识别的库、其关联模块以及这些库在生成程序中的预期用途，如示例 4 所示。

paragraphs.en: Using the generated dependency specification, Analyzer interacts with the Documentation Retrieval module to retrieve the official documentation corresponding to the identified libraries. Since the retrieved documentation may contain redundant or task-irrelevant information, Analyzer performs a filtering step to retain only the documentation relevant to the identified dependencies. Specifically, it removes duplicated and unrelated content while preserving verified import statements, API descriptions, and usage examples associated with the required modules. The prompt instructs the LLM to return the extracted dependencies according to a predefined JSON schema, ensuring that the output can be reliably processed by subsequent components. The generated JSON representation contains the identified libraries, their associated modules, and their intended usage within the generated program, as illustrated in Listing 4 .

paragraphs.en: The Documentation Retrieval module supports Analyzer by collecting authoritative and task-relevant API documentation for the dependencies identified during task analysis. Given the structured dependency specification produced by Analyzer , the module queries trusted web sources using the DuckDuckGo Search API and retrieves official documentation pages corresponding to the required libraries and submodules. Rather than exposing raw documentation to subsequent stages, the Documentation Retrieval module processes the retrieved pages to extract concrete artifacts that are directly useful for code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 文档检索模块通过分析器在任务分析过程中识别出的依赖项，收集权威且与任务相关的 API 文档，从而为分析器提供支持。 基于分析器生成的结构化依赖规范，该模块使用 DuckDuckGo 搜索 API 查询可信的网页来源，并获取所需库和子模块对应的官方文档页面。 文档检索模块不会将原始文档直接暴露给后续阶段，而是对检索到的页面进行处理，提取出对代码生成有直接帮助的具体成果。

sents.en: Given the structured dependency specification produced by Analyzer , the module queries trusted web sources using the DuckDuckGo Search API and retrieves official documentation pages corresponding to the required libraries and submodules.
sents.zh: 基于分析器生成的结构化依赖规范，该模块使用 DuckDuckGo 搜索 API 查询可信的网页来源，并获取所需库和子模块对应的官方文档页面。

sents.en: Rather than exposing raw documentation to subsequent stages, the Documentation Retrieval module processes the retrieved pages to extract concrete artifacts that are directly useful for code generation.
sents.zh: 文档检索模块不会将原始文档直接暴露给后续阶段，而是对检索到的页面进行处理，提取出对代码生成有直接帮助的具体成果。

paragraphs.en: First, the module parses the HTML content using BeautifulSoup and identifies code blocks and text segments containing API usage information. It then extracts import statements and usage patterns from these extracted sections by analyzing the code examples provided in the documentation. For instance, it identifies valid imports such as from langchain.tools import tool and retains short code snippets that demonstrate the correct usage of the corresponding APIs. These patterns capture common operations relevant to agent-based and LLM-driven workflows, such as initializing chains, configuring retrievers, instantiating agents, and invoking LLM calls, while discarding explanatory text and unrelated examples. The output of this module is an intermediate documentation bundle consisting of two components: (i) a list of verified import statements and (ii) a collection of concise, executable usage snippets.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，该模块使用 BeautifulSoup 解析 HTML 内容，并识别出包含 API 使用信息的代码块和文本片段。 接着，它通过分析文档中提供的代码示例，从这些提取出的部分中抽取导入语句和使用模式。 例如，它能识别出有效的导入语句，如 from langchain.tools import tool，并保留展示对应 API 正确使用的简短代码片段。 这些模式涵盖了与智能体驱动和 LLM 驱动工作流相关的常见操作，例如初始化链、配置检索器、创建智能体实例以及调用 LLM，同时会排除解释性文本和无关示例。 该模块的输出是一个中间文档包，包含两个组成部分：(i) 经过验证的导入语句列表，以及 (ii) 一系列简洁且可执行的代码使用片段。

paragraphs.en: The Compilation and Dependency Management module assists Validator by performing systematic checks that ensure the generated code is syntactically valid and supported by the execution environment. Upon receiving a candidate implementation from Code Generator , the module compiles the generated code without executing its program logic. If compilation fails, the resulting error logs are provided to Validator , which analyzes the errors together with the task requirements and retrieved documentation to determine whether the generated solution requires correction and to formulate appropriate feedback for the next generation iteration.
paragraphs.zh: 编译与依赖管理模块通过执行系统性检查来协助验证器，确保生成的代码在语法上有效且受执行环境支持。 在从代码生成器接收到候选实现后，该模块会编译生成的代码，但不会执行其程序逻辑。 如果编译失败，系统会将产生的错误日志提供给验证器；验证器将结合任务要求和检索到的文档分析这些错误，以判断生成的解决方案是否需要修正，并为下一轮生成迭代制定适当的反馈。

paragraphs.en: When the compilation succeeds, the module extracts all import statements from the source code and verifies whether the corresponding package is available in the execution environment. Missing dependencies are automatically installed using pip through the subprocess module after verifying their availability on PyPI. For instance, if langchain is missing, the system attempts to install it by running a pip install langchain command in a subprocess and then verifies that the module can be successfully imported using importlib .

These logs are then forwarded to Validator to support higher-level validation and decision-making.

paragraphs.en: The Validator agent serves as the quality assurance component of our agentic pipeline, responsible for systematically evaluating the functional correctness and library conformance of the code produced by the Code Generator. Upon receiving a candidate implementation, the Validator first inspects the compilation logs and dependency resolution status provided by the Compilation module. This includes verifying whether all required third-party packages were successfully installed, whether import statements resolved to actual modules in the current environment, and whether any runtime errors—such as ModuleNotFoundError or AttributeError , were triggered during attempted execution.
paragraphs.zh: 验证智能体作为我们智能体流程的质量保证组件，负责系统性地评估代码生成器所产生代码的功能正确性和库兼容性。 在收到候选实现后，验证智能体首先会检查编译模块提供的编译日志和依赖解析状态。 这包括验证所有必需的第三方包是否成功安装、导入语句在当前环境中是否解析为实际模块，以及在尝试执行时是否触发了任何运行时错误——例如 ModuleNotFoundError 或 AttributeError。

paragraphs.en: Next, the Validator cross-references the generated imports and API calls against the filtered documentation bundle prepared earlier by the Analyzer. For instance, if the code uses from langchain.chat_models import ChatOpenAI , the Validator checks whether this path exists in the current LangChain documentation. If it has been relocated (e.g., to langchain_openai.ChatOpenAI ), the Validator flags this as an error. In addition to structural validation, the Validator assesses semantic alignment with the original task specification. It verifies that the chosen libraries and components fulfill the functional requirements implied by the natural language prompt. This prevents situations where the code compiles successfully, but fails to implement the intended behavior due to incomplete or misconfigured library usage. When issues are detected, the Validator constructs structured, actionable feedback. This feedback includes issue category, the exact location in the code, a description of the mismatch, and specific correction instructions. The feedback is then passed back to the Code Generator, which uses it to regenerate only the affected portions of the code while preserving the rest of the implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，验证器会将生成的导入语句和 API 调用与分析师先前准备好的过滤后的文档包进行交叉核对。 例如，如果代码中使用了 from langchain.chat_models import ChatOpenAI，验证器会检查该路径是否存在于当前的 LangChain 文档中。 如果路径已被重命名（例如，改为 langchain_openai.ChatOpenAI），验证器会将此标记为错误。 除了结构验证外，验证器还会评估代码与原始任务说明在语义上的一致性。 它会验证所选的库和组件是否满足自然语言提示所隐含的功能需求。 这可以防止代码虽然成功编译，但由于库使用不完整或配置错误而未能实现预期行为的情况。 当检测到问题时，验证器会构建结构化且可操作的反馈信息。 该反馈信息包括问题类别、代码中的确切位置、不匹配的描述以及具体的修正说明。 随后，该反馈会被传回代码生成器，后者会据此仅重新生成受影响的代码部分，同时保留其余的实现内容。

paragraphs.en: The entire loop repeats iteratively until the solution satisfies the validation criteria or reaches the configured maximum number of iterations. At each iteration, the Validator re-evaluates the updated code using the same rigorous criteria, ensuring progressive convergence toward a fully correct and executable solution.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate our approach, we address the following research questions (RQs):
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们的方法，我们针对以下研究问题（RQs）展开探讨：

paragraphs.en: How effective is the proposed system in solving library-related issues across different LLMs?
paragraphs.zh: 在不同大型语言模型（LLM）中，所提出的系统在解决图书馆相关问题方面的效果如何？

paragraphs.en: To measure the effectiveness of our approach, we evaluate it on a dataset of 300 code generation tasks. To put the results into context, we compare it against a baseline where we use direct prompting. We assess both approaches using the code correctness rate, the total number of library-related errors, and the error reduction rate across five language models. We also analyze the reduction achieved for individual library-related error categories.
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量我们方法的有效性，我们在一个包含 300 个代码生成任务的数据集上对其进行了评估。 为了让结果更具参照性，我们将该方法与直接使用提示的基线方法进行了比较。 我们通过代码正确率、库相关错误的总数以及五个语言模型中的错误减少率来评估这两种方法。 我们还分析了各类别库相关错误所实现的减少程度。

sents.en: We assess both approaches using the code correctness rate, the total number of library-related errors, and the error reduction rate across five language models.

sents.en: We also analyze the reduction achieved for individual library-related error categories.

paragraphs.en: How do the individual components of the proposed system contribute to its overall effectiveness?

paragraphs.en: To understand the contribution of each component to the system performance, we perform an ablation study in which we compare variants of the system by removing one component from the complete design while keeping all other components unchanged. Specifically, we evaluate the impact of removing the Analyzer, Documentation Retrieval, Compilation and Dependency Management, and Validator modules under the same experimental conditions, measuring their individual contributions to reducing library-related errors and improving code executability.
paragraphs.zh: 为了理解每个组件对系统性能的贡献，我们进行了一项消融研究：在完整的设计中移除一个组件，同时保持所有其他组件不变，从而比较系统的不同变体。 具体来说，我们在相同的实验条件下评估了移除 Analyzer、Documentation Retrieval、Compilation and Dependency Management 以及 Validator 模块所带来的影响，并测量了这些模块各自在减少库相关错误和提高代码可执行性方面的贡献。

paragraphs.en: In the following, we present the dataset construction process, evaluation metrics, and experimental configurations used in the evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将介绍数据集构建过程、评估指标以及评估中使用的实验配置。

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, no existing dataset is specifically designed to evaluate the ability of LLM-based systems to detect and resolve library-related errors caused by rapidly evolving APIs. Therefore, we curate a new dataset to evaluate our proposed approach. We selected five widely adopted and rapidly evolving frameworks used in LLM-powered applications, namely LangChain , AutoGen , CrewAI , LlamaIndex , and Agno . These frameworks were selected based on their popularity in real-world LLM application development and their frequent evolution, as reported in previous studies [ 27 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，目前没有任何现有数据集是专门用于评估基于大型语言模型（LLM）的系统检测并解决因快速演变的 API 所引发的库相关错误的能力的。 因此，我们构建了一个新的数据集来评估我们提出的方法。 我们选择了五个在 LLM 驱动的应用中广泛采用且快速演变的框架，即 LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、LlamaIndex 和 Agno。 这些框架的选择依据是它们在真实世界 LLM 应用开发中的流行程度以及频繁演变的特点，正如先前研究 [27] 所报告的。

sents.en: To the best of our knowledge, no existing dataset is specifically designed to evaluate the ability of LLM-based systems to detect and resolve library-related errors caused by rapidly evolving APIs.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，目前没有任何现有数据集是专门用于评估基于大型语言模型（LLM）的系统检测并解决因快速演变的 API 所引发的库相关错误的能力的。

sents.en: Therefore, we curate a new dataset to evaluate our proposed approach.

sents.en: These frameworks were selected based on their popularity in real-world LLM application development and their frequent evolution, as reported in previous studies [ 27 ] .

paragraphs.en: Following the repository selection and prompt-generation methodology described in Section III-A , we collected Python implementations from open-source GitHub repositories associated with the selected frameworks. However, to reflect recent library versions and usage patterns, we specifically selected repositories that were created or actively maintained after June 2025. We further retained implementations representing realistic LLM-powered application scenarios whose functionality depends on the correct use of external libraries and APIs.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循第 III-A 节中描述的仓库选择和提示生成方法，我们从与所选框架相关的开源 GitHub 仓库中收集了 Python 实现。 然而，为了反映最新的库版本和使用模式，我们特别选择了在 2025 年 6 月之后创建或仍在活跃维护的仓库。 此外，我们还保留了能够代表真实 LLM 驱动应用场景的实现，这些场景的功能依赖于对外部库和 API 的正确使用。

sents.en: Following the repository selection and prompt-generation methodology described in Section III-A , we collected Python implementations from open-source GitHub repositories associated with the selected frameworks.
sents.zh: 遵循第 III-A 节中描述的仓库选择和提示生成方法，我们从与所选框架相关的开源 GitHub 仓库中收集了 Python 实现。

sents.en: However, to reflect recent library versions and usage patterns, we specifically selected repositories that were created or actively maintained after June 2025.
sents.zh: 然而，为了反映最新的库版本和使用模式，我们特别选择了在 2025 年 6 月之后创建或仍在活跃维护的仓库。

sents.en: We further retained implementations representing realistic LLM-powered application scenarios whose functionality depends on the correct use of external libraries and APIs.
sents.zh: 此外，我们还保留了能够代表真实 LLM 驱动应用场景的实现，这些场景的功能依赖于对外部库和 API 的正确使用。

paragraphs.en: For each selected implementation, we used ChatGPT to generate a corresponding natural language code-generation task by extracting its intended functionality. As in the exploratory dataset, the prompts describe the expected behavior while intentionally omitting framework-specific class names, import paths, and low-level implementation details. The original implementations were used only as references for task construction and were not provided to the evaluated models.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个选定的实现，我们使用 ChatGPT 通过提取其预期功能来生成一个对应的自然语言代码生成任务。 与探索性数据集中一样，提示描述了预期的行为，但有意省略了框架特定的类名、导入路径和底层实现细节。 原始实现仅用作任务构建的参考，并未提供给被评估的模型。

sents.zh: 对于每个选定的实现，我们使用 ChatGPT 通过提取其预期功能来生成一个对应的自然语言代码生成任务。

sents.en: As in the exploratory dataset, the prompts describe the expected behavior while intentionally omitting framework-specific class names, import paths, and low-level implementation details.

paragraphs.en: The prompts were manually reviewed by two annotators to ensure that they accurately represented the intended functionality without exposing implementation-specific information. This design requires the evaluated LLMs to independently determine the appropriate library APIs and implementation rather than reproduce the original source code.
paragraphs.zh: 两名标注员对提示进行了人工审核，以确保其准确反映了预期功能，同时不会暴露与具体实现相关的信息。 这种设计要求被评估的大型语言模型独立确定合适的库 API 和实现方式，而不是直接复现原始源代码。

paragraphs.en: The final dataset contains 300 code-generation tasks covering diverse LLM application scenarios, including agent coordination, tool usage, document processing, and modular pipeline composition.
paragraphs.zh: 最终数据集包含 300 个代码生成任务，涵盖了多种大语言模型（LLM）应用场景，包括智能体协同、工具使用、文档处理以及模块化流程构建。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the generated files using metrics that measure overall correctness and the effectiveness of the proposed system in improving code generation reliability, particularly its ability to mitigate library-related issues.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用衡量整体正确性的指标来评估生成的文件，并评估所提出系统在提升代码生成可靠性方面的有效性，尤其是其缓解库相关问题的能力。

paragraphs.en: In addition to these metrics, we perform an error category analysis to examine how the proposed system affects different types of library-related issues.
paragraphs.zh: 除了这些指标之外，我们还进行了错误类别分析，以考察所提出的系统如何影响不同类型的图书馆相关问题。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our proposed system using five LLMs: GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3, Mistral, and Llama 3. These models were selected to cover diverse LLM families, including both proprietary and open-weight models, and to represent different levels of code generation capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用五种大型语言模型（LLM）来评估我们提出的系统：GPT-5、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3、Mistral 和 Llama 3。 选择这些模型是为了涵盖不同的大型语言模型家族，包括专有模型和开放权重模型，并体现不同的代码生成能力水平。

sents.en: We evaluate our proposed system using five LLMs: GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3, Mistral, and Llama 3.

paragraphs.en: This section presents the results of our evaluation according to the defined research questions. We first investigate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in reducing library-related errors and improving the correctness of generated code (RQ1). We then analyze the contribution of individual system components through an ablation study (RQ2).
paragraphs.zh: 本节根据既定的研究问题，呈现我们评估的结果。 我们首先研究所提方法在减少库相关错误和提高生成代码正确性方面的有效性（RQ1）。 接着，我们通过消融研究分析各个系统组件的贡献度（RQ2）。

paragraphs.en: Table II summarizes the results of our system compared to direct prompting across all models. Our proposed system consistently improves overall correctness across all evaluated models, demonstrating the effectiveness of its library-aware retrieval and validation mechanisms. It increases the correctness rate by 4% for GPT-5, 12% for DeepSeek-V3, 15% for Qwen3, 14% for Mistral, and 16% for Llama 3. The larger improvements observed for open-weight models indicate that they benefit more from access to external library knowledge and automated validation. However, the improvements achieved by GPT-5 also demonstrate that the proposed approach provides complementary benefits beyond model capability alone.
paragraphs.zh: 表 II 总结了我们的系统与直接提示在所有模型上的对比结果。 我们提出的系统在所有评估模型中均持续提升整体正确率，证明了其库感知检索与验证机制的有效性。 该系统将 GPT-5 的正确率提升了 4%，DeepSeek-V3 提升了 12%，Qwen3 提升了 15%，Mistral 提升了 14%，Llama 3 提升了 16%。 开源模型中观察到的提升幅度更大，表明它们从访问外部库知识和自动化验证中获益更多。 然而，GPT-5 所取得的提升也表明，该方法提供的益处超越了模型能力本身。

paragraphs.en: A similar pattern is observed for overall library-related errors. Across all evaluated models, our system substantially reduces the total number of library-related errors, achieving reductions of 38.1% for GPT-5, 41.8% for DeepSeek-V3, 42.5% for Qwen3, 54.6% for Mistral, and 48.1% for Llama 3. These results confirm that integrating library-aware retrieval and validation into the generation process substantially enhances code correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 在整体库相关错误中，也观察到了类似的模式。 在所有评估的模型中，我们的系统显著减少了库相关错误的总数，分别使 GPT-5、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3、Mistral 和 Llama 3 的错误数量降低了 38.1%、41.8%、42.5%、54.6% 和 48.1%。 这些结果证实，将库相关的检索与验证整合到生成过程中，能够显著提升代码的正确性。

paragraphs.en: The magnitude of the improvements varies across models depending on their initial performance under direct prompting. Models with a higher number of library-related errors, particularly open-weight models, benefit more substantially from the proposed system, achieving reductions exceeding 40% in total library errors and improvements of up to 16% in code correctness. This can be attributed to the ability of documentation grounding and validation mechanisms to provide reliable external library knowledge during generation. Nevertheless, GPT-5, which already achieves strong results under direct prompting, still benefits from the proposed system, demonstrating that the approach improves code correctness even for strong proprietary models. These findings highlight that the proposed system enhances LLM-based code generation by integrating up-to-date library knowledge and automated validation rather than merely compensating for limitations in model knowledge.

paragraphs.en: Table II presents a detailed comparison of the proposed system and direct prompting across different categories of library-related errors. The results show that the proposed system consistently reduces all error categories across the evaluated models. The largest improvements are observed for hallucinated libraries, deprecated library usage, and incorrect import paths, which represent challenging failures caused by outdated or incomplete library knowledge. For hallucinated libraries, the proposed system substantially reduces errors across all models. For example, the number of hallucinated library errors decreases from 31 to 13 for GPT-5 (60.7% reduction) and from 48 to 21 for DeepSeek-V3 (58.1% reduction). Similar reductions are observed for the remaining models, demonstrating that grounding code generation with retrieved documentation helps prevent the generation of non-existent libraries.
paragraphs.zh: 表 II 详细比较了所提出系统与直接提示方法在不同类别的库相关错误上的表现。 结果表明，在评估的所有模型中，所提出系统能够持续减少所有类型的错误。 最大的改进体现在幻觉库、过时库使用以及错误的导入路径上，这些错误源于陈旧或不完整的库知识所带来的复杂问题。 对于幻觉库问题，所提出系统在所有模型中均显著减少了错误。 例如，在 GPT-5 中，幻觉库错误的数量从 31 个减少到 13 个（降幅为 60.7%），而在 DeepSeek-V3 中则从 48 个减少到 21 个（降幅为 58.1%）。 其余模型也观察到了类似的错误减少，这表明通过检索文档对代码生成进行约束，有助于防止生成不存在的库。

paragraphs.en: To investigate the contribution of each component to the overall effectiveness of the proposed system, we conduct an ablation study using DeepSeek-V3. DeepSeek-V3 was selected for this study as a representative open-weights model because it achieved the strongest overall performance and largest error reduction among open models in RQ1, making it an ideal testbed to observe how modular components impact system capability. Specifically, we compare the complete system against four variants, each obtained by removing one optional component while keeping the remaining components unchanged. Since the Code Generation module represents the core mechanism responsible for producing the final program, it remains enabled in all configurations. This analysis evaluates the individual contribution of the Analyzer agent, Validator agent, Documentation Retrieval module, and Compilation module in improving code correctness and reducing library-related errors. The results are presented in Table III .

paragraphs.en: The results demonstrate that each component contributes to the overall performance of the proposed system. Removing any individual component leads to a decrease in correctness rate and an increase in library-related errors compared with the complete configuration. The full system achieves the best performance, reaching a correctness rate of 83%, while producing the lowest number of library-related errors (114) and affected files (51). These results confirm that the effectiveness of the proposed approach relies on the complementary interaction between its different components.

paragraphs.en: Finally, disabling the Compilation module results in a correctness rate of 81%, with 132 library-related errors and 56 affected files. paragraphs.en: The results presented in Section VI-A show that library-related issues remain a persistent challenge for LLM-based code generation, even when using recent and capable models. Across all evaluated models, direct prompting leads to incorrect dependency usage, including invalid imports, deprecated APIs, and unsupported library components. These findings are consistent with prior studies showing that LLMs often struggle with API evolution and library misuse due to their reliance on pre-trained knowledge that may not reflect the current state of software ecosystems [ 6 , 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 第六节A部分展示的结果表明，即使使用近期且功能强大的模型，与库相关的问题仍然是基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代码生成中持续存在的挑战。 在所有评估的模型中，直接提示都会导致依赖项使用错误，包括无效的导入、过时的API以及不受支持的库组件。 这些发现与先前的研究一致，这些研究表明，由于大型语言模型（LLM）依赖可能无法反映当前软件生态系统状态的预训练知识，因此它们常常难以应对API的演化和库的误用 [6, 7]。

paragraphs.en: The improvements achieved by our approach demonstrate that supplementing LLMs with external and up-to-date library knowledge can effectively reduce these limitations. As shown in Section VI-A , integrating documentation retrieval and validation reduces library-related errors across all evaluated models, indicating that these errors are not solely caused by insufficient model capability. Instead, they are partly caused by the absence of mechanisms that connect code generation with the current state of external libraries. By retrieving relevant documentation and validating generated code against library constraints, the proposed approach provides information that is complementary to the model’s pre-trained knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法所取得的改进表明，通过为大型语言模型补充外部且最新的库知识，可以有效减少这些局限性。 如第六节 A 部分所示，整合文档检索与验证能够降低所有受评估模型中与库相关的错误，这表明这些错误并非完全由模型能力不足所致。 相反，这些错误部分源于缺乏将代码生成与外部库当前状态连接起来的机制。 通过检索相关文档并验证生成代码是否符合库的约束条件，所提出的方法提供了对模型预训练知识具有补充作用的信息。

paragraphs.en: However, our approach does not completely eliminate all library-related failures. Some errors remain when the retrieved documentation does not provide sufficient information about specific APIs, when multiple libraries interact in complex ways, or when the generated solution requires reasoning beyond the available documentation. These cases highlight opportunities for future research, such as improving documentation retrieval strategies, incorporating version-aware reasoning, and developing more advanced validation mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，我们的方法并未完全消除所有与库相关的故障。 当检索到的文档未提供有关特定 API 的足够信息、多个库以复杂方式相互作用，或生成的解决方案需要超出可用文档范围的推理时，仍会存在一些错误。 这些情况凸显了未来研究的机会，例如改进文档检索策略、引入版本感知推理以及开发更先进的验证机制。

paragraphs.en: Overall, our findings suggest that improving LLM-based code generation requires not only increasing model capabilities but also integrating external knowledge and verification mechanisms that can adapt to the continuously changing software ecosystem.

paragraphs.en: The impact of documentation retrieval highlights the importance of providing LLMs with current and task-specific API information. Without this component, the model must rely mainly on its pre-trained knowledge, which can contain outdated or conflicting library usage patterns. Similarly, the contribution of the Analyzer demonstrates the importance of explicitly identifying required dependencies before generation. By making dependencies explicit, the system reduces incorrect assumptions about library availability and usage. The contribution of the Compilation and Validator modules further confirms that generation alone is insufficient, as automatically generated code requires continuous verification to detect and correct issues that cannot be identified during generation.

paragraphs.en: These observations align with previous research on retrieval-augmented generation and agent-based software engineering systems, which shows that combining generation with external knowledge sources and feedback mechanisms can improve reliability in complex tasks [ 28 ] . Our results extend these findings by showing that such mechanisms are particularly valuable for library-dependent code generation, where correctness depends not only on program logic but also on compatibility with evolving external APIs.

paragraphs.en: Our results show that library-related errors remain common across all evaluated LLMs when code is generated using direct prompting alone. In particular, incorrect import paths consistently represented the most frequent category of errors, indicating that current LLMs struggle to keep pace with rapidly evolving software libraries and changing package structures. These findings suggest that relying solely on an LLM’s internal knowledge is insufficient for producing reliable, dependency-heavy code. Software teams should therefore integrate documentation-aware retrieval mechanisms into AI-assisted development workflows, allowing models to retrieve current library documentation before generating code [ 28 ] . By grounding generation in up-to-date documentation, practitioners can avoid the time-consuming process of manually scouring external release notes or API references to diagnose broken imports.

paragraphs.en: Our ablation study further demonstrates that documentation retrieval alone is insufficient for maximizing code correctness. While the Documentation Retrieval module produced the largest standalone improvement, removing the validation and refinement stages still resulted in lower execution success. This finding highlights the importance of combining documentation grounding with automated verification. Organizations developing AI-assisted software engineering tools should therefore integrate compilation, dependency validation, and iterative refinement into their development pipelines to detect and resolve library-related issues before deployment. Automating these validation and refinement steps eliminates tedious trial-and-error debugging loops, saving developers substantial time and engineering bandwidth that would otherwise be spent manually resolving subtle, cascading dependency failures [ 29 , 30 ] .

paragraphs.en: Our findings demonstrate that accurate dependency identification is a fundamental component of library-aware code generation. The Analyzer agent, which constructs structured dependency specifications prior to documentation retrieval, played a key role in enabling the framework to retrieve relevant documentation while avoiding unnecessary context. These results suggest that future research should focus on intelligent context selection rather than simply expanding context windows with large volumes of documentation. Developing methods that automatically identify the libraries, APIs, and relevant documentation snippets required for a given programming task has the potential to further improve the reliability and efficiency of retrieval-augmented code generation systems [ 32 ] .

paragraphs.en: Although our framework reduced library-related errors by up to 54.6%, a portion of generated programs still failed after the maximum number of refinement iterations. This suggests that iterative validation alone is insufficient to recover from certain classes of dependency-related errors once generation diverges from a correct solution. Future work should therefore investigate more effective error recovery strategies, including richer compiler feedback, adaptive documentation retrieval, improved multi-agent collaboration, and fine-tuning approaches that leverage iterative debugging and code repair traces. Such techniques could further improve the robustness of agentic code generation systems beyond the capabilities demonstrated in this work [ 33 ] .

paragraphs.en: In this section, we discuss threats to the validity of our work.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将讨论对我们研究有效性的威胁。

paragraphs.en: Threats to internal validity involve the extent to which our findings accurately reflect the phenomena studied without being compromised by bias or confounding factors. The construction of the evaluation benchmark represents a potential source of bias. The prompts were initially generated with the assistance of an LLM based on real-world implementations collected from GitHub repositories involving rapidly evolving Python frameworks. While this approach facilitated the creation of realistic and diverse tasks, automated prompt generation may introduce variations in task formulation or inadvertently influence the difficulty of the resulting problems. To mitigate this threat, all generated prompts were manually reviewed, refined, and validated by the authors to ensure alignment with the original developer intent, preservation of the targeted library usage challenges, and consistency across benchmark instances.
paragraphs.zh: 对内部效度的威胁涉及我们的研究结果在多大程度上能够准确反映所研究的現象，而不会受到偏见或混淆因素的影响。 评估基准的构建可能成为偏见的潜在来源。 这些提示最初是在大型语言模型（LLM）的帮助下生成的，其依据是从 GitHub 仓库中收集到的真实世界应用案例，这些案例涉及快速演变的 Python 框架。 虽然这种方法有助于创建真实且多样化的任务，但自动化的提示生成可能会在任务表述上引入差异，或无意中影响最终问题的难度。 为缓解这一威胁，作者对所有生成的提示进行了人工审查、优化和验证，以确保其符合开发者的原始意图，保留目标库使用中的挑战，并保证基准实例之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Threats to external validity involve the extent to which our findings hold in other contexts. Threats to external validity may arise from the choice of evaluation frameworks, as the characteristics of the selected ecosystems may influence the observed performance of the proposed system. To mitigate this concern, we selected LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI, which are considered the most widely used frameworks for developing LLM-based applications. These ecosystems are characterized by rapid evolution and frequent API updates, making them highly representative and challenging environments for studying library-related errors in LLM-generated code. Nevertheless, the findings may not directly generalize to more stable libraries or ecosystems in other programming languages, such as Java, JavaScript, or C++. As part of future work, we plan to evaluate our system on a broader set of frameworks and programming languages to further assess its generalizability across diverse software ecosystems.

paragraphs.en: Another threat is the generalizability of our results to different underlying LLM. paragraphs.en: Prior studies have shown that LLM-generated code suffers from systematic errors that limit its reliability in practical software engineering settings. Empirical investigations have identified recurring failure modes across models, prompts, and programming tasks, revealing limitations beyond traditional human-written bugs [ 34 , 35 ] . Tambon et al. [ 11 ] conducted a large-scale analysis of LLM-generated bugs and proposed a taxonomy including hallucinated objects, incorrect attributes, and semantic inconsistencies. Their findings show that LLM-generated errors differ from conventional software bugs, requiring specialized analysis approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究已经表明，大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码存在系统性错误，这些错误限制了其在实际软件工程环境中的可靠性。 实证研究已识别出不同模型、提示和编程任务中反复出现的故障模式，揭示了超越传统人工编写代码的错误的局限性 [ 34 , 35 ] 。Tambon 等人 [ 11 ] 对 LLM 生成的错误进行了大规模分析，并提出了一种分类体系，包括幻觉对象、错误属性以及语义不一致性。 他们的研究结果表明，LLM 生成的错误与传统软件错误存在差异，因此需要专门的分析方法。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work focuses on dependency and library-related hallucinations [ 10 , 24 ] . These studies demonstrate that LLMs frequently generate non-existent APIs, deprecated methods, and incorrect imports. Such failures are particularly common in rapidly evolving frameworks, where outdated training knowledge leads models to reference obsolete or invalid components [ 36 ] . Spracklen et al. [ 37 ] further show that LLMs may recommend non-existent packages or misuse existing libraries through incorrect aliases, missing submodules, or incompatible API combinations. These issues directly affect code executability and may introduce security risks. Despite these findings, existing evaluations of LLM-generated code largely emphasize functional correctness, often overlooking library- and import-related failures [ 38 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究关注依赖关系和库相关的幻觉问题 [ 10 , 24 ] 。 这些研究表明，大型语言模型（LLM）经常生成不存在的 API、已弃用的方法以及错误的导入。 这类错误在快速演进的框架中尤为常见，因为过时的训练知识会导致模型引用过时或无效的组件 [ 36 ] 。Spracklen 等人 [ 37 ] 进一步指出，大型语言模型（LLM）可能会推荐不存在的包，或通过错误的别名、缺失的子模块或不兼容的 API 组合误用现有库。 这些问题会直接影响代码的可执行性，并可能引入安全风险。 尽管有这些发现，现有对大型语言模型生成代码的评估大多强调功能正确性，常常忽视与库和导入相关的错误 [ 38 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of research focuses on improving library- and API-aware code generation to reduce errors in LLM outputs. These approaches aim to mitigate hallucinated dependencies, incorrect imports, and misused APIs by grounding generation in external knowledge and structuring the synthesis process. One line of work imposes library-aware generation strategies. For example, CodeGen4Libs [ 39 ] generates import statements before the main code, reducing inconsistent or unused dependencies. A 3 -CodGen [ 40 ] enriches generation with repository-level context, including global project structure, local files, and third-party libraries, helping to avoid library incompatibilities and logical errors. While these methods improve consistency within a stable project, they are less effective for frameworks undergoing rapid structural reorganization where the "correct" repository-level context is a moving target.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究致力于改进对库和 API 有感知能力的代码生成，以减少大型语言模型输出中的错误。 这些方法旨在通过将生成过程基于外部知识并结构化合成流程，来缓解幻觉依赖、错误导入和 API 误用的问题。 其中一类研究采用了具有库感知能力的生成策略。 例如，CodeGen4Libs [ 39 ] 会在主代码之前生成导入语句，从而减少不一致或未使用的依赖项。 A 3 -CodGen [ 40 ] 通过加入仓库级别的上下文信息来丰富生成过程，包括全局项目结构、本地文件和第三方库，有助于避免库不兼容和逻辑错误。 尽管这些方法能在稳定的项目中提升一致性，但对于那些框架结构正在快速重组、导致“正确”的仓库级上下文不断变化的情况，它们的效果则相对有限。

paragraphs.en: Another strand emphasizes retrieval-augmented or API-grounded generation. De-Hallucinator [ 41 ] iteratively retrieves relevant documentation to refine prompts and improve correct API usage. Related methods leverage formal API specifications or natural-language documentation at generation time, ensuring outputs align with verified interfaces rather than relying solely on the model’s internal knowledge [ 42 , 43 ] . Recent research also frames correct library usage as a planning and exploration problem. ExploraCoder [ 44 ] decomposes unfamiliar API usage into structured subtasks to guide correct invocation. Other agentic approaches integrate execution feedback, tool calls, or iterative self-refinement to detect and repair invalid imports or API calls [ 45 , 46 ] . These methods tightly couple generation with validation, producing more reliable code in the presence of complex libraries and evolving dependencies.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we investigated library-related issues in LLM-generated code and proposed an agentic approach to mitigate these errors. Our exploratory study of 100 LLM-generated programs revealed that 84% of instances contain at least one library-related error, with common patterns including incorrect import paths, missing imports, hallucinated libraries, deprecated usage, and unused imports. Based on these findings, we designed a library-aware generation approach combining dependency analysis, documentation grounding, code generation, and automated validation. We evaluated our approach on 300 programming tasks from rapidly evolving Python frameworks across five LLMs. The results show that our system consistently improves code correctness, reducing library-related errors by 38.1%–54.6% and increasing correctness by up to 16%. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of documentation grounding and validation mechanisms for improving the reliability of LLM-generated code.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码中存在的库相关问题，并提出了一种智能体驱动的方法以缓解这些错误。 我们对 100 个由 LLM 生成的程序进行的探索性研究显示，84% 的实例至少包含一个与库相关的错误，常见模式包括错误的导入路径、缺失的导入、虚构的库、弃用用法以及未使用的导入。 基于这些发现，我们设计了一种具备库感知能力的生成方法，结合了依赖分析、文档 grounding、代码生成和自动化验证。 我们在五个 LLM 上，使用来自快速演进的 Python 框架的 300 个编程任务对我们的方法进行了评估。 结果表明，我们的系统能够持续提高代码正确性，将库相关错误减少了 38.1%–54.6%，并将正确性提升了最高达 16%。 这些发现证明了文档 grounding 和验证机制在提升 LLM 生成代码可靠性方面的有效性。
